title: Mixed meeting preserves progress and troubleshooting priorities
request: I need to report progress, explain a failed replication, and ask which diagnostic to run next.
source_material: The replication failed with a shape mismatch before training.
Two diagnostics were supplied: inspect batching or inspect feature dimensions.
must_include: Select a primary and secondary intent.
Retain the failure and ask the advisor to prioritize a supplied diagnostic.
must_not_include: Treat preprocessing completion as replication success.
Invent a cause for the shape mismatch.
